package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

// LearningActionAssistanceRepository stores the assistance audit and outbox
// envelope in one transaction.
type LearningActionAssistanceRepository struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (repository LearningActionAssistanceRepository) Record(
	ctx context.Context,
	assistance domain.LearningActionAssistance,
	event domain.IntegrationEvent,
) error {
	if repository.Pool == nil {
		return errors.New("learning action assistance repository pool is required")
	}
	tx, err := repository.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()

	if err := insertAssistanceAndEvent(ctx, tx, assistance, event); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return tx.Commit(ctx)
}

// Finalize atomically records source-event deduplication and optional output.
func (repository LearningActionAssistanceRepository) Finalize(
	ctx context.Context,
	closure domain.LearningActionClosed,
	assistance *domain.LearningActionAssistance,
	event *domain.IntegrationEvent,
) (bool, error) {
	if repository.Pool == nil {
		return false, errors.New("learning action assistance repository pool is required")
	}
	normalized, err := domain.NewLearningActionClosed(closure)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if (assistance == nil) != (event == nil) {
		return false, errors.New("assistance and event must both be present or absent")
	}
	if assistance != nil && (assistance.StudentID != normalized.StudentID ||
		assistance.LearningActionID != normalized.LearningActionID ||
		assistance.CorrelationID != normalized.CorrelationID ||
		assistance.CausationID != normalized.EventID ||
		assistance.ContextType != normalized.ContextType || assistance.ContextID != normalized.ContextID) {
		return false, errors.New("teacher assistance does not match learning action closure")
	}

	tx, err := repository.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{})
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	result, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO teacher_integration_inbox (
    event_id,
    event_type,
    schema_version,
    student_id,
    correlation_id,
    causation_id,
    learning_action_id,
    occurred_at,
    processed_at
) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, now())
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
`,
		normalized.EventID,
		domain.SubjectLearningActionClosed,
		domain.LearningActionClosedSchemaVersion,
		normalized.StudentID,
		normalized.CorrelationID,
		normalized.CausationID,
		normalized.LearningActionID,
		normalized.OccurredAt,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if result.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return false, nil
	}
	if assistance != nil {
		if err := insertAssistanceAndEvent(ctx, tx, *assistance, *event); err != nil {
			return false, err
		}
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return true, nil
}

func insertAssistanceAndEvent(
	ctx context.Context,
	tx pgx.Tx,
	assistance domain.LearningActionAssistance,
	event domain.IntegrationEvent,
) error {
	if event.Subject != domain.SubjectTeacherAssistanceObserved || event.StudentID != assistance.StudentID ||
		event.CorrelationID != assistance.CorrelationID || event.CausationID != assistance.CausationID ||
		!event.OccurredAt.Equal(assistance.CreatedAt) {
		return errors.New("teacher assistance event does not match assistance")
	}
	observations, err := json.Marshal(assistance.Observations)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO teacher_learning_action_assistance (
    id,
    personal_teacher_id,
    student_id,
    correlation_id,
    causation_id,
    learning_action_id,
    context_type,
    context_id,
    support_context,
    hints_used,
    max_hint_level,
    intervention_used,
    observations,
    policy_version,
    created_at
) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NULLIF($5, ''), $6, $7, NULLIF($8, ''), $9, $10, $11, $12, $13::jsonb, $14, $15)
`,
		assistance.ID,
		assistance.PersonalTeacherID,
		assistance.StudentID,
		assistance.CorrelationID,
		assistance.CausationID,
		assistance.LearningActionID,
		assistance.ContextType,
		assistance.ContextID,
		assistance.SupportContext,
		assistance.HintsUsed,
		assistance.MaxHintLevel,
		assistance.InterventionUsed,
		string(observations),
		assistance.PolicyVersion,
		assistance.CreatedAt,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	_, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO teacher_outbox (
    event_id,
    subject,
    schema_version,
    student_id,
    correlation_id,
    causation_id,
    occurred_at,
    payload,
    next_attempt_at,
    created_at
) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NULLIF($6, ''), $7, $8::jsonb, $9, $10)
`,
		event.EventID,
		event.Subject,
		event.SchemaVersion,
		event.StudentID,
		event.CorrelationID,
		event.CausationID,
		event.OccurredAt,
		string(event.Payload),
		event.OccurredAt,
		event.OccurredAt,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}
